text:
maria: Quick sync — can we get a short status update on the Console Insights work (dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention changes)? Need concrete owners, blockers, and whether the milestones below still hold for this sprint.

tim: Owners + quick status: dashboards -> jasper (PR open), tracing hooks -> alyssa (PoC merged to staging), error-analysis -> olivia (schema draft), retention policy + rollout -> tim (coordinating infra). Milestones: dashboards canary 2026-04-06, tracing rollout 2026-04-12, retention decision 2026-04-08.

jasper: Dashboard scope checklist: usage by route, token cost by model, error-rate by tag, per-route latency percentiles. PR: https://redwood-internal/pull/5493 — PTAL @maria @tim. Only outstanding is final UX for the error panel (paired with olivia).

alyssa: Tracing hooks status: core instrumentation merged, sampler + prefix-KV tagging still WIP. Blocker: trace-store quota; need infra to bump the storage tier for retention testing. Filed infra ticket: https://redwood-internal/issue/554 (requesting +2TB for staging).

olivia: Error-analysis view: schema draft posted in docs, need dash fields for stack trace sampling and linked trace_id. Also require small SDK change (tag propagation). Please tag me on the SDK PR, I can review and supply example evals.

tim: Retention config prototype (example):
```yaml
retention:
  default_days: 30
  longtail_days: 365
  tiering: enabled
  archive_after_days: 400
```
Need decision on longtail vs archive policy before we enable auto-tiering. This affects cost estimates and SLA for queries.

jasper: Quick question — who owns final UX wording for the new error panel and the link target when expanded? @maria? I can implement once copy is final.

maria: I can own copy for the error panel. Also action items: 1) infra to ack ticket 554 by EOD, 2) owners add epic links to the roadmap doc, 3) jasper to merge dashboard PR after small UX tweak.

alyssa: FYI — SRE will need a rollback plan documented for tracing rollout (latency spike risk). Drafting playbook and will post in #eng-sre.

deploy-bot: Canary report — dashboards v1 on canary cluster: 5/5 checks passed; sample load tests show p50 within SLO.

olivia: I'll add the error->trace linking to the schema and open the SDK PR today. ETA for review: tomorrow morning.

tim: Ok — summary/takeaways: owners confirmed (jasper, alyssa, olivia, tim), infra blocker (ticket 554) is highest priority, retention decision needed by 2026-04-08 or we delay auto-tiering. Can everyone update their epics and drop a single-line status in the roadmap doc by EOD?

maria: Thank you. If infra can't approve 554 today, tag @tim and we'll escalate. Otherwise we'll proceed with dashboard canary on 2026-04-06 and tracing canary once storage is green.

jasper: Will merge dashboard PR after UX tweak and ping here.

alyssa: Will post SRE rollback playbook and link it shortly.

(maria pinned the roadmap doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/console-insights-roadmap)
